title: NAAIL Adversarial Benchmark V2 — POC Core

principles.synthetic_label: All mutations are synthetic benchmark fixtures, never allegations about source authors.
principles.clean_control: A clean control must produce no error finding beyond documented limitations.
principles.judgment_gate: Judgment-dependent mutations may require HUMAN_REVIEW rather than deterministic PASS/FAIL.
principles.evidence_boundary: Missing evidence cannot be VERIFIED and does not imply an author error.

cases.fixture: Change one reported coefficient while preserving executable output
Narrative says statistically significant when reported uncertainty does not support it
Remove one declared control/fixed effect from executable specification
Change clustered inference to non-clustered standard errors while manuscript still states clustering
Duplicate merge key to create unintended many-to-many expansion
Shift predictor availability forward one period to introduce look-ahead
Scale one monetary input by 1000 without corresponding definition change
Allow target-period information into feature construction
Rewrite an associational conclusion as a causal claim without design change
Remove one required dependency/artifact from package manifest
Change runtime/library version outside pinned environment
Remove seed/state control from stochastic execution
Point table lineage to an output generated by a different specification
Introduce hidden macro/external state that changes execution
Look-ahead data leakage plus narrative performance claim
Omit fixed effect, retain stale table lineage, and alter one reported coefficient
Hidden environment drift plus dynamic external state; evaluator sees package only
Hidden merge-cardinality expansion changes analytic sample

scoring.traceability: finding must cite evidence refs and taxonomy id
scoring.compound_rule: score exact taxonomy IDs and family-level detection separately
scoring.human_review_rule: correct escalation counts as detection when fixture is judgment-dependent
